_about: Guard attire (guard/uniform.py). uniforms: body-slot item names (as the game reports them, case ignored) that mark the wearer as one of a force. 'org' links a force to a guard career in orgs.json, if there is one. A name not listed but containing "guard's armor" counts as the guard of the hold the player is in. attitudes: how particular people feel about that force, from Skyrim lore only (no dice): who matches by exact name, race, or a word in their name, optionally only in some places. Everyone not listed is ordinary: a guard is a guard. stance: approve | respect | wary | distrust | despise. Each NPC's own regard for the player (relationship: affinity, trust, respect) softens or hardens it, so it can be won over.
